title: Exact condition qualification through native public admission and ordinary delivery
question: Can the current release publish only independently supported condition or assumption roles, keep failed siblings, and replay the exact assertion from ordinary and detached readers?
method: Exercise isolated textbook and business source controls through ordinary PostgreSQL admission. Use the authenticated Standard p289 source and retained M1 annotations for current-release scoped qualification; preserve the phrase reference and refusal. Submit independently authored role anchors under a separate frame of the released policy. Preserve the old projection's detached and reprojection refusals. Qualify the same independently judged source passage under the current v10 projection from compatible retained Standard native records, without repeating recognition.
commands: PYTEST_XDIST_AUTO_NUM_WORKERS=2 uv run ci test --json -- python/corpus-structure/tests/methods/test_scoped_relations.py -k condition_host_preserves
uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-09_pm2-public-condition/variance_journey.py initialize --release RELEASE --realization REALIZATION

uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-09_pm2-public-condition/variance_journey.py reproject --native-baseline-view 276 --release RELEASE --realization REALIZATION --attempt pm2-p289-standard-v10-1

uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-09_pm2-public-condition/variance_journey.py freeze --reference-design DESIGN --release RELEASE --group grinstead-snell --partition development --a A.json --b B.json --c C.json
uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-09_pm2-public-condition/variance_journey.py stage --release RELEASE --realization REALIZATION --reference REFERENCE.json --attempt ATTEMPT

uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-09_pm2-public-condition/variance_journey.py publish --release RELEASE --realization REALIZATION --reference REFERENCE.json --staged STAGED.json --attempt ATTEMPT
uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-09_pm2-public-condition/variance_journey.py verify-delivery --publication PUBLICATION.json --delivery-root DELIVERY_ROOT

results.name: Native publication and refusal across two vocabularies
Actual p289 exact role admission and delivery

conclusion: The existing release publishes an exact source-first condition or assumption only when the independent structural support matches both role anchors. It rejected the original phrase reference and admitted a separately authored exact role reference. The compatible v10 source pin preserves the exact physical p289 evidence and delivers its assertion through ordinary and detached surfaces. This one exposed textbook case and controlled business case do not establish full-book or interpretation-provider qualification.
